# frozen_string_literal: true

require "yaml"
require_relative "errors"

module ActTasks
  # Loads registered YAML and validates explicit task metadata without inferring roles.
  class TaskStore
    VALID_ACCESS = %w[write read_only].freeze

    # Binds the task directory without I/O. Filesystem errors occur on reads.
    def initialize(root)
      @root = root
    end

    # Returns one validated YAML task by ID. InvalidTask marks absent tasks or
    # invalid metadata; native filesystem, YAML and shape exceptions propagate.
    def load(id)
      path = task_path(id)
      raise InvalidTask, "task not found: #{id}" unless File.file?(path)

      task = YAML.safe_load_file(path, aliases: false) || {}
      validate!(task, path)
      task
    end

    # Returns validated tasks in filename order; raises the same errors as load.
    def all
      Dir.glob(File.join(@root, "*.yml")).sort.map do |path|
        task = YAML.safe_load_file(path, aliases: false) || {}
        validate!(task, path)
        task
      end
    end

    # Returns the YAML path for an ID without checking existence or reading it.
    def task_path(id)
      File.join(@root, "#{id}.yml")
    end

    private

    # Validates a loaded task mapping, preserving unrelated metadata. Callers
    # ignore its return; InvalidTask identifies invalid fields or guidance/policy.
    def validate!(task, path)
      id = task["id"]
      title = task["title"]
      repositories = task["repositories"]

      raise InvalidTask, "#{path}: id is required" unless id.is_a?(String) && !id.empty?
      raise InvalidTask, "#{path}: title is required" unless title.is_a?(String) && !title.empty?
      unless repositories.is_a?(Hash) && !repositories.empty?
        raise InvalidTask, "#{path}: repositories must be a non-empty mapping"
      end

      repositories.each do |name, spec|
        raise InvalidTask, "#{path}: repository name must be a string" unless name.is_a?(String) && !name.empty?
        unless spec.is_a?(Hash) && VALID_ACCESS.include?(spec["access"])
          raise InvalidTask, "#{path}: #{name} access must be write or read_only"
        end
      end

      depends_on = task.fetch("depends_on", [])
      raise InvalidTask, "#{path}: depends_on must be an array" unless depends_on.is_a?(Array)

      if task.key?("planning_guidance") && task["planning_guidance"] != "required"
        raise InvalidTask, "#{path}: planning_guidance must be the scalar string required when present"
      end

      if task.key?("checkpoint")
        policy = task["checkpoint"]
        unless policy.is_a?(Hash) && %w[required exempt].include?(policy["mode"]) &&
               (policy.keys - %w[mode category reason]).empty?
          raise InvalidTask, "#{path}: checkpoint mode must be required or exempt"
        end
        if policy["mode"] == "exempt"
          unless %w[planning inspection no_code].include?(policy["category"]) &&
                 policy["reason"].is_a?(String) && !policy["reason"].strip.empty?
            raise InvalidTask, "#{path}: checkpoint exemption requires category and reason"
          end
        elsif policy.keys != ["mode"]
          raise InvalidTask, "#{path}: required checkpoint takes only mode"
        end
      end

      if task.key?("worker_recommendation")
        recommendation = task["worker_recommendation"]
        unless recommendation.is_a?(Hash)
          raise InvalidTask, "#{path}: worker_recommendation must be a mapping"
        end
        %w[model thinking].each do |field|
          value = recommendation[field]
          unless value.is_a?(String) && !value.empty?
            raise InvalidTask, "#{path}: worker_recommendation #{field} must be a non-empty string"
          end
        end
      end

      %w[constraints acceptance].each do |field|
        value = task.fetch(field, [])
        raise InvalidTask, "#{path}: #{field} must be an array" unless value.is_a?(Array)
      end
    end
  end
end

# frozen_string_literal: true

require "digest"

module ActObservability
  # Bounded binary capture at the native gate boundary. Console delivery and
  # durable capture have independent outcomes; neither changes command success.
  class GateCapture
    LIMIT = 4 * 1024 * 1024

    # Binds a private gate directory and invocation token plus existing consoles.
    # Missing storage is reported as unavailable, without preventing execution.
    def initialize(directory, token, out:, err:)
      @directory, @token = directory, token
      @consoles = { "stdout" => out, "stderr" => err }
      @streams, @writers, @threads = {}, {}, []
    end

    # Yields native system redirections and returns the block result. Always
    # closes/drains owned pipes, retaining partial evidence on spawn/interrupt.
    # Original exceptions propagate; stalled inherited pipes have bounded cleanup.
    def run
      @consoles.each do |name, console|
        reader, writer = IO.pipe
        reader.binmode
        writer.binmode
        @writers[name.to_sym] = writer
        @threads << Thread.new { drain(name, reader, console) }
      end
      yield @writers.transform_keys { |key| key == :stdout ? :out : :err }
    ensure
      @writers.each_value { |writer| writer.close unless writer.closed? }
      @threads.each do |thread|
        next if thread.join(1)
        thread.kill.join
      end
    end

    # Returns explicit per-stream counts, digests and completeness. Paths are
    # basenames relative to this invocation's checkpoint directory. No output
    # bytes or environment values enter the receipt. Does not claim durability
    # for absent/partial files or failed flush/fsync operations.
    def result
      { "status" => @streams.values.all? { |spec| spec["status"] == "complete" } && @streams.length == 2 ? "complete" : "incomplete",
        "limit_per_stream" => LIMIT, "streams" => @streams }
    end

    private

    # Drains binary bytes to a capped private file and the original console.
    # Capturing/presentation failures remain separate from command status. Files
    # are never overwritten; incomplete captures survive forced thread cleanup.
    def drain(name, reader, console)
      spec = { "status" => "pending", "bytes" => 0, "observed_bytes" => 0,
        "console" => "complete", "file" => "gate-#{@token}.#{name}" }
      @streams[name] = spec
      file = nil
      begin
        raise IOError unless @directory
        file = File.open(File.join(@directory, spec["file"]), File::WRONLY | File::CREAT | File::EXCL | File::NOFOLLOW, 0o600)
        file.binmode
      rescue IOError, SystemCallError, NotImplementedError
        spec["status"] = "persistence_error"
      end
      loop do
        bytes = reader.readpartial(16_384)
        spec["observed_bytes"] += bytes.bytesize
        if file
          begin
            retained = bytes.byteslice(0, [LIMIT - spec["bytes"], bytes.bytesize].min)
            file.write(retained)
            spec["bytes"] += retained.bytesize
          rescue IOError, SystemCallError, NotImplementedError
            spec["status"] = "persistence_error"
            file.close rescue nil
            file = nil
          end
        end
        if spec["console"] == "complete"
          begin
            console.write(bytes)
            console.flush if console.respond_to?(:flush)
          rescue IOError, SystemCallError
            spec["console"] = "delivery_error"
          end
        end
      end
    rescue EOFError
      spec["status"] = spec["observed_bytes"] > LIMIT ? "truncated" : "complete" if spec["status"] == "pending"
    ensure
      if file
        begin
          file.flush
          file.fsync
          file.close
          spec["sha256"] = Digest::SHA256.file(File.join(@directory, spec["file"])).hexdigest
          File.open(@directory, File::RDONLY, &:fsync)
        rescue IOError, SystemCallError, NotImplementedError
          spec["status"] = "persistence_error"
        ensure
          begin
            file.close unless file.closed?
          rescue IOError, SystemCallError
            spec["status"] = "persistence_error"
          end
        end
      end
      spec["status"] = "incomplete" if spec["status"] == "pending"
      reader.close unless reader.closed?
    end
  end
end

# frozen_string_literal: true

require "fileutils"

module ActLifecycle
  # Serializes scheduling and lifecycle writers with the existing launch lock.
  module ReservationLock
    # Yields a private, owned exclusive lock for data_root, returning the block's
    # value. A caller may pass its held IO to avoid recursive locking. Unsafe
    # paths, foreign files and competing holders raise InvalidState; IO errors
    # propagate. The borrowed lock stays open and locked for its caller.
    def self.synchronize(data_root, held: nil)
      root = "#{File.realpath(data_root)}-runs"
      cursor = root
      loop do
        raise InvalidState, "reservation: symlinked evidence path" if File.symlink?(cursor)
        break if cursor == File.dirname(cursor)

        cursor = File.dirname(cursor)
      end
      if File.exist?(root) && !File.directory?(root)
        raise InvalidState, "reservation: foreign evidence root"
      end
      FileUtils.mkdir_p(root, mode: 0o700)
      unless File.stat(root).uid == Process.uid && (File.stat(root).mode & 0o077).zero?
        raise InvalidState, "reservation: foreign evidence root"
      end
      path = File.join(root, "launch.lock")
      if File.symlink?(path) || (File.exist?(path) && !File.file?(path))
        raise InvalidState, "reservation: foreign/symlinked lock"
      end

      if held
        validate!(path, held)
        return yield held
      end

      File.open(path, File::RDWR | File::CREAT | File::NOFOLLOW, 0o600) do |lock|
        validate!(path, lock)
        yield lock
      end
    end

    # Checks path/IO identity, ownership, privacy and exclusivity before use.
    # Returns true or raises InvalidState for foreign or busy reservations.
    def self.validate!(path, lock)
      actual = File.lstat(path)
      opened = lock.stat
      unless actual.file? && opened.file? && actual.nlink == 1 &&
             [actual.dev, actual.ino] == [opened.dev, opened.ino] &&
             opened.uid == Process.uid && (opened.mode & 0o077).zero?
        raise InvalidState, "reservation: foreign/symlinked lock"
      end
      raise InvalidState, "reservation lock: launch/recovery reservation busy; retry" unless lock.flock(File::LOCK_EX | File::LOCK_NB)

      true
    end
    private_class_method :validate!
  end
end
